text:
maya (oncall): seeing alerts for customer-notify queue but incidentbot didn't page. multiple high-severity alerts 1795000xx now. any idea?
ops-bot: auto-alert: notify-queue error rate spike detected, alert_id=AN-4921, suppressed_pagers=3 (reason=webhook-429).
maya (oncall): confirmed — PD shows no new incidents created after 1795000050. customers reporting delayed pages. sam-cs: customers on enterprise tier hit retry limits and opened tickets.
dave.sre: I'm on it, looking at webhook-proxy logs. initial quick grep shows repeated 429 responses from downstream pager gateway. attaching short tail: 
```
2026-03-17T09:34:12Z WARN webhook-proxy rate_limited client_id=redwood-ingest retry_after=30 status=429
2026-03-17T09:34:38Z WARN webhook-proxy rate_limited client_id=incidentbot retry_after=30 status=429
2026-03-17T09:34:59Z ERROR forwarder failed to deliver incident payload status=502
```
leah-eng: was there a config change on the proxy or a rollout? I saw a small deploy to notify-proxy earlier but not sure if rate caps changed.
dave.sre: checking deploy history... `kubectl rollout history deploy/webhook-proxy -n infra` shows a config bump 30m ago, PR #4987 changed default rate_limit policy. rolling it back now.
maya (oncall): while rollback happens, we need to make sure on-call gets pages. manual workaround: leah, can you trigger PD incidents directly from the alert infra?
leah-eng: yes, can run `curl -X POST https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents` with service key, doing manual creates for affected alerts. doing 3 manual pages now.
incidentbot: automated message: incidentbot detected alert AN-4921 but webhook-proxy response=429, scheduling retry in 30s.
maya (oncall): manual pages sent, pinged oncall via PD. we should also reduce suppressor TTL so future 429s don't cause long suppression.
dave.sre: rollback completed at 1795000550. verifying: tailing logs show no more 429s for incidentbot client_id.
ops-bot: heartbeat: alert ingestion resumed, suppressed_pagers cleared.
sam-cs: customers confirm pages arriving now, one enterprise customer says they got pages ~4m late but are back to normal.
leah-eng: follow-up action: open PR to add canary rate-limit for webhook-proxy and add alert that triggers if incidentbot gets >2 consecutive 429s. assigning to dave.sre.
dave.sre: ack. I'll also add a fallback route that bypasses the proxy for incidentbot traffic if we detect proxy throttling.
maya (oncall): handoff note for next oncall: issue was proxy rate cap change, manual pages performed, rollback applied, customers impacted briefly. started postmortem ticket PM-612. please include timeline and mitigation runbook.
incidentbot: automated: incidentbot resumed normal operation at 1795000723 after successful retries.
leah-eng: small note — ops playbook update: add step to trigger PD manual incident if incidentbot receives 2 consecutive non-5xx errors (4xx like 429).
maya (oncall): closing slack thread, moving to incident channel for postmortem writing. thanks all :thumbsup:
